rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely: same receiver names, doc style, cookieFilterAction reuse, Validate/CaddyModule/UnmarshalCaddyfile shape, registration and interface assertions placed beside cookie.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through, exact name match, quoting preserved, empty suffix and delete handled; hashed values are re-quoted too and leading whitespace before the name is dropped on rebuild (minor).
rationale.scope: Focused on the feature; small extras are the added CookieFilter Validator assertion and an unrequested []string branch, both harmless.
rationale.readability: Clear flow and names; the separate delete check before the switch is slightly awkward and could be a switch case.
rationale.robustness: Uses stdlib http.ParseSetCookie, no panics on bad input, unknown Interface types returned unchanged, value receiver with read-only access to actions.
rationale.maintainability: Reuses hash, filterAction and cookieFilterAction, but UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's rather than a shared helper.
